author: HarryRules2002
body:
So this is how I got banned. I played one game of walls, first game I found the glitch, snow kicked me while i was in another teams quadrant. The next game I join back, I play usually. A kid sends a DIFFERENT mod screenshots of me being over the wall before they dropped. So he temp banned me even though it was my first offence and they just misunderstood. The screenshots he sent were from the previous game.

Thankyou for giving me the opportunity to appeal :D

replies.author: resepignev
replies.body:
Hello Harry/HairyBalls2002,

as you said snow kicked you for abusing a glitch. That was your warning that it's not allowed and that you should stop abusing the glitch.

You got reported by a player (not naming any names), that you are in the middle between the walls and that you are looting the chests. That was around 50 minutes after you got the warning/kick by snow.

I told you that you were abusing a glitch and that you should stop doing it. You said you would put back everything you gathered from the middle, what you gladly did.

After the game and after you left, some players pointed out and as you said in one of your replies, you knew that what you were doing was wrong and you did it on purpose.

Based of the fact that the punishment increases with each offense, I decided to temporary ban you for 3 days, which is only a light temporary ban.

And the player you mentioned that sent a screenshot to me didn't contacted me after the game over skype or any other communication platform.
Snow took a screenshot of you while you were stacking up on the walls [http://imgur.com/QLhVRcc].
So did I while you were in the middle at the chests [http://i.imgur.com/RhzPUf1.png].
As you can see the walls have different colors (on the top), so it wasn't the same game.
